title: NLP-gestützte Erschließung von Metadaten in epigraphischen Datenbanken. Figürliche Darstellungen auf spätantiken Grabinschriften: Ikonographisches Vokabular, Goldstandard und Methodenvergleich am Datensatz der EDH
description: A multilingual iconographic vocabulary (374 depicted elements, category tree, German/Latin/English search terms, 354 motif rules), aligned with Iconclass and the EAGLE vocabulary "Decoration"; a hand-annotated gold standard of 1,100 randomly drawn comments of the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (EDH), with a concordance to Trismegistos and EDCS; and a comparison of four methods (dictionary matching, lemmatisation, dependency parsing, fine-tuned BERT) that extract iconographic motifs from the free-text comments, with the complete code to reproduce all reported scores.
notes: Produced within the HERMES research study programme (https://www.hermes-hub.de/formate/forschungsstudien/), funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) and the European Union (NextGenerationEU). Data in data/ and figures/: CC BY-SA 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Code in src/: MIT (LICENSE). Comment texts, EDH ids, datings, Trismegistos and EDCS links from the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (CC BY-SA 4.0).
